title: How to Save Money Every Month
excerpt: Find a sustainable amount to save and build it into your monthly routine.
introduction: Saving works best when the amount fits your real life. This guide uses a fictional PKR example to show how a small change can become a repeatable routine. No return or outcome is guaranteed.
author: Hisabki Kitab Editorial Team

blocks.text: Waiting until the last day of the month to save often leaves nothing to move aside.

Start by observing your spending. Choose one flexible cost you can reduce without cutting essentials, then set a savings amount that still leaves enough for bills. If essentials already exceed income, the immediate task is resolving that shortfall.
Bilal reduces optional takeout spending by PKR 1,500 and cancels an unused PKR 500 subscription. He chooses to save that PKR 2,000 each month.
PKR 2,000 ? 12 months = PKR 24,000 contributed in one year, before any fees or returns, assuming no withdrawals.

items: Review the last month of transactions.
Pick one or two flexible expenses to reduce.
Choose an affordable savings amount after essential bills.
Move the money to a separate savings pot when income arrives.
Review after one month and adjust if the target caused a shortfall.
Saving so aggressively that you need to borrow for food.
Counting a discount as savings when you bought something unnecessary.
Ignoring fees on the account used for savings.

blocks.text: Make it easier to keep going
If income varies, try a small contribution when each payment arrives and reassess essentials first.
A modest amount you can repeat is a useful beginning. Increase it when your circumstances allow.

sources.title: CFPB: Your Money, Your Goals toolkit

faqs.question: How much should I save each month?
faqs.answer: There is no single amount for everyone. Choose a contribution that remains affordable after essential costs and required payments.

faqs.question: When should I move money into savings?
faqs.answer: Many people find it easier to set aside an affordable amount when income arrives, then review the plan regularly.
